text: {"us_status":"partial","label_product":"POTELIGEO (mogamulizumab-kpkc) injection, for intravenous use","label_version_or_date":"DailyMed setid e53960ab-42a1-40d1-9c7d-eb013fe7f18f; version 21; effective time 20260302; Revised 3/2026","label_section":"6.2 Postmarketing Experience","quote":"Gastrointestinal disorders: Immune-mediated colitis","eu":"EU: PRAC Feb 2025 recommended adding colitis to SmPC 4.8 as common and to the package leaflet; current EMA PI lists colitis as common and describes watery diarrhoea.","uk":"UK: MHRA product information/SmPC lists gastrointestinal disorders: common colitis and describes it as mainly watery diarrhoea.","us_regulator":"FDA: public sBLA S-025 approval letter states immune-mediated colitis was added to Section 6.2; no colitis-specific AEMS/FAERS potential-signal listing found, but FDA/Sentinel has public descriptive mogamulizumab-kpkc NME utilization queries not specific to colitis.","sources":["https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/fda/fdaDrugXsl.cfm?setid=e53960ab-42a1-40d1-9c7d-eb013fe7f18f&type=display","https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2026/761051s025lbl.pdf","https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/appletter/2026/761051Orig1s025ltr.pdf","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/prac-recommendation/prac-recommendations-signals-adopted-10-13-february-2025-meeting_en.pdf","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/product-information/poteligeo-epar-product-information_en.pdf","https://mhraproducts4853.blob.core.windows.net/docs/bb77da17615e79603c91ab3a89d30d23e305dae1","https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-product-information-about-medicines","https://www.fda.gov/drugs/fda-adverse-event-monitoring-system-aems/new-safety-information-or-potential-signals-serious-risks-identified-fda-adverse-event-monitoring","https://www.sentinelinitiative.org/sites/default/files/documents/Sentinel_Report2_cder_mpl1r_wp298.pdf"]}
